_comment: Editable template for optional complete hardware profiles, not runtime input.
Canonical A5 Cube/HBM/link values live in hap_platform_constants.public.json;
null A5 public fields below are filled from that file. Fill remaining values from official documentation
(https://www.hiascend.com/document) for your devices, then save this file
910b2/950pr/910c blocks are required for the complete models. 950dt is
optional: omit its block until all missing fields are available. cube / vec_basic take one entry per dtype the unit
supports (e.g. float16 / bfloat16 / float32 / int8 / ...) at the
datasheet peak rate; replace the '<dtype>' placeholders.
vec_basic MUST include a 'float32' entry: it is the fallback rate for
dtypes without an entry of their own (see hap_lib.vec_rate).
Units: hbm/l2/link in bytes/s; l2cap in bytes; cube in FLOP/s; vec_basic and
cast_rate in element-op/s; sfu_factor/div_factor as fractions of basic.
hap_lib validates the file on load and reports exactly what is missing.
